roomRequirements.description: For courses that need hours split across multiple room types (e.g. 4h in a computer center + 1h in a standard room). Leave empty to just use the single Room Requirement above.

blockTemplates.title: Block Templates (custom)
blockTemplates.description: Explicit, hand-authored blocks for this course instead of letting the generic decomposition derive them. Leave Group empty to apply to every group taking this course. A group's own template for a given block index overrides the "all groups" one.

blockTemplates.pinnedRequiresTimeslotError: A pinned template must specify a preferred timeslot
blockTemplates.none: No block templates — this course uses the generic decomposition above.

courses.precedenceNote: How this course’s blocks are decided: Block Templates take priority over Room Requirements, which take priority over the legacy Room Requirement field on the Details tab. Only the highest-priority source with data for a given block is used.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Each "Generate PDFs" run keeps its own set of files instead of overwriting the last one, so past runs stay here to compare against newer ones.
reports.runningSuffix: — a new run is being generated now.

importExcel.title: Import Excel
importExcel.description: Upserts base problem data (Teachers, Courses, Rooms, Groups, Group_Courses sheets) by ID/name — existing rows are updated, new ones created. Does not touch timeslots or the solved schedule; run the solver afterward to assign the imported courses/groups.
importExcel.importedSummary: Imported: {{teachers}} teachers, {{courses}} courses, {{rooms}} rooms, {{groups}} groups, {{groupCourses}} group-course links.
importExcel.rejected: Import rejected — nothing was written. Fix these and re-upload:
importExcel.exportDescription: Downloads the current data as an .xlsx workbook in the exact format Import Excel expects, for a full export -> edit -> re-import round trip. Export everything, or just one entity (Groups also includes Group_Courses). Does not include timeslots or the solved schedule.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Admin-only configuration for values used across the scheduler.

solver.title: Solver
solver.description: Runs the solver as a background process (scripts/run-engine.sh) and writes results straight to the database. This can take up to a few minutes.
solver.limitsDescription: Applies to this run only — solverConfig.xml itself isn't changed. Leave the defaults (5 / 2) unless you have a reason to run longer or shorter.

complianceSnapshots.title: Compliance Snapshots
complianceSnapshots.description: Admin-only. A calendario-incumplimientos.pdf snapshot is generated automatically right after each successful engine run, capturing that run's constraint violations at the moment it finished. Stored separately from the Reports tab and visible only to ADMIN.
complianceSnapshots.none: No compliance snapshots yet — run the solver above to generate one.

generateBlocks.title: Generate Blocks
generateBlocks.description: Creates the unassigned schedule blocks the solver needs, one per (group, course) pair in Group_Courses, decomposing each course's required hours into 1-2 hour blocks. Only fills gaps — a (group, course) pair that already has blocks is left untouched, so this is safe to re-run after importing new groups/courses. Run this after the Import tab and before Start Engine.
generateBlocks.resultSummary: Created {{created}} block(s); skipped {{skipped}} pair(s) that already had blocks.

clearTimeslots.title: Clear Unpinned Timeslots
clearTimeslots.description: Unassigns the timeslot on every block that isn't pinned, leaving pinned placements untouched. Teacher and room assignments are not affected. Use this to discard a solve (or a bad manual edit) before running the engine again.
clearTimeslots.confirm: Clear the timeslot on every unpinned block? Pinned blocks won't be touched. This can't be undone.
clearTimeslots.resultSummary: Cleared the timeslot on {{count}} unpinned block(s).

term.title: Current Term
term.description: A free-text label shown in the header for everyone (e.g. "Fall 2026"). Purely organizational - the solver never reads it.

auditLog.title: Recent Activity
auditLog.description: The most recent 200 write actions (create/update/delete), logged automatically for accountability.

blockRules.title: Block Rules
blockRules.description: Sets the preferred block size (1-4h) used to decompose a course's weekly hours when generating blocks, and the max blocks per day the solver allows for the same course/group, per course designation. A designation with no rule here defaults to 2h blocks and 2 blocks/day.
blockRules.confirmDelete: Reset {{component}} to the defaults (2h blocks, 2 blocks/day)?
blockRules.none: No custom block rules configured — every designation uses the default 2h block size and 2 blocks/day.
blockRules.sizeHint: Blocks are packed greedily at this size, with a smaller trailing block for any leftover hours.
blockRules.maxBlocksPerDayHint: The solver will not place more than this many blocks of the same course, for the same group, on one day.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Track the school's holiday, exam, and half-day dates. Record-keeping only for now — not yet used by block generation or the solver.

users.title: Users
users.description: Admin-only. Manages who can sign in and with which role (ADMIN, WRITER, READER). You can't delete your own account, and the last remaining enabled ADMIN can't be deleted, demoted, or disabled.

schedule.title: Schedule View

mySchedule.title: My Schedule
